Card Q&A.q: Can I use "・1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn" in this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to give the same Digimon -2000 DP multiple times?
Can I use "・1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn" in this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to give different Digimon -2000 DP?

Card Q&A.a: No, it isn't deleted yet. This card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect activates "・1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn" 4 times, then all Digimon with 0 DP are deleted at the same timing.
Card Q&A.q: I activated "・1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn" in this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect once, and the DP of the opponent's Digimon became 0. Is that Digimon deleted before the effect activates 3 more times?

Effect: {Hand} [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Activate the effect below 4 times:
・1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When other Digimon are deleted, you may play 1 level 4 or lower [NSo] trait Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
Special Rule: ＜Overflow (-4)＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
